requirements.evidence: Build has 4 pieces at 0,0,0 / 0,-1,0 / 1,-1,0 / 1,0,0 only; no spike and no drawer present. Earlier tested spike at junction 0,-1|0,0|1,-1 with a notch drawer frame at 1,0 (k2) which is the notch adjacent to that same junction, but the final configuration was not retained and mesh-touch verification was not completed before turn limit. check_build meshClash=clear with only warnings LOOSE_BODY and OPEN_CAP_FACE.

finish.summary: Could not complete drawer+spike at same corner in allotted turns. Current build is 4 bases in a loop with no drawer/spike; requires finishing notch-drawer+spike colocation and verifying meshes touch.
